title: Quadrature-Enhanced Monte Carlo fPINN Method for High-Dimensional Fractional PDEs
summary: Fractional PDEs involving the fractional Laplacian on bounded domains are challenging because of hypersingular nonlocal kernels, exterior Dirichlet constraints, reduced boundary regularity, and the high computational cost in high dimensions. To address these issues, we first adopt a spatially varying radius with directional distance-to-boundary information, which yields a geometry-adaptive three-part decomposition of the fractional Laplacian: singular near-field, regular interior far-field, and analytical exterior far-field contributions.
